categories.main_business_segments: Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of molds, automotive inspection fixtures, automated tooling equipment, and automotive parts. Its core business centers on automotive interior and exterior molds, including soft trim and foam molds used for manufacturing automotive components such as roofs, carpets, seats, door panels, and instrument panels. The company also extends into automotive inspection fixtures and automated production lines, serving both traditional and new energy vehicle sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including injection molding with foaming processes, hot pressing for thermoplastic composites, and 3D sand printing for mold casting. It operates full-process manufacturing capabilities from R&D, design, wooden model making, casting, CNC machining, assembly, to mold testing and maintenance. The firm employs sophisticated equipment such as five-axis CNC machining centers and laser hardening machines, supported by proprietary manufacturing execution and mold design systems to ensure high precision and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive parts suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) such as Geely, FAW-Volkswagen, and SAIC-GM. The company serves the automotive industry, focusing on interior and exterior trim suppliers and new energy vehicle manufacturers like Tesla, NIO, and BYD. Its products are used in passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles, with a strong presence in both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in the Yangtze River Delta region, a major automotive industry hub. It has established wholly-owned subsidiaries in Europe (Germany), North America (USA), and Southeast Asia (Thailand) to support overseas sales and provide technical services, thereby covering key global automotive markets including Europe, North America, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer of specialized molds and tooling equipment essential for automotive parts production. It also extends downstream by supplying automotive inspection fixtures and automated production equipment to automotive parts manufacturers and OEMs, enabling integrated solutions for automotive interior and exterior component manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in mold design and manufacturing technologies, including development of cushioning core-pulling mechanisms, 3D printed sand molds, and automated flexible tooling systems. It invests significantly in R&D to enhance product quality, reduce production costs, and support new energy vehicle applications. Strategic priorities include expanding capacity through capital projects, enhancing automation, and strengthening global market penetration while maintaining leadership in automotive interior and exterior mold technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized molds, automotive inspection fixtures, and automated tooling equipment to automotive parts suppliers and OEMs. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with pricing determined per contract considering production complexity, costs, and market conditions. It also earns investment income from financial products and government subsidies, but the core revenue stems from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of automotive interior and exterior molds, particularly in soft trim and foam mold segments. It is recognized as one of the largest suppliers in China with strong technical capabilities and a broad customer base. It competes with other specialized mold manufacturers domestically and internationally, leveraging its full-process manufacturing, advanced technology, and integrated 'mold, inspection, tooling' service offerings to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 720.7 million, representing a 14.9% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96.6 million, up 1.24%. Total assets reached RMB 2.13 billion with net assets of RMB 1.44 billion, reflecting steady growth. The company maintains a healthy financial position with positive cash flows from operations and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co., Ltd. differentiates itself through its comprehensive full-process manufacturing capability, enabling control over quality and delivery timelines. It offers integrated solutions combining molds, inspection fixtures, and automated tooling, tailored to customer-specific needs. The company holds numerous patents and industry certifications, leads in foam mold technology standards, and provides strong after-sales technical support globally, delivering high-quality, innovative, and reliable products to automotive manufacturers.
